query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integracoes_api (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  nome VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  siteUrl VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  apiUrl VARCHAR(500),
  apiKey VARCHAR(255),
  apiDocUrl VARCHAR(500),
  status ENUM('ativa', 'inativa', 'descobrindo') DEFAULT 'descobrindo' NOT NULL,
  tipoAutenticacao ENUM('api_key', 'oauth', 'bearer', 'basic', 'nenhuma') DEFAULT 'nenhuma',
  metodoEnvio VARCHAR(50),
  formatoDados ENUM('json', 'form-data', 'xml') DEFAULT 'json',
  testadoEm TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ultimoEnvio TIMESTAMP NULL,
  totalEnvios INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
